lines.say: He didn't leave you. His job changed his Thursdays.
Night shifts, a move, a new schedule. Life takes more regulars than the shop down the street.
And he probably won't ask, because he figures you're full.
So ask first. Did your schedule change? I've got Saturday mornings open.
New time, same barber, same regular.
Comment the word keep and we'll show you who's drifted. Message Health dot net.
